description_en: Removes a protected object from a scenario-specific custom policy
description_zh: 移除定制场景策略的防护对象
name: DetachSceneDefenseObject

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159382.html operation to query the IDs of all policies
parameters.help_zh:
策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159382.html查询所有策略ID
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the object. Set the value to Domain, which indicates a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 对象类型。取值：Domain，表示域名
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The protection asset that you want to remove from a policy. Separate multiple protection assets with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要移除的防护对象。多个对象间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: objects

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
Success.description_zh:
是否成功调用。取值：
true：是
false：否
